units.source_text: 阿笑知道，在冬日的竹林子里，只要躺在厚厚的枯竹叶上，就会感到暖融融的。

en.t: Axiao knew that in the bamboo grove on a winter day, if she lay down on the thick layer of withered bamboo leaves, she would feel warmly comfortable.

units.source_text: 她身上虽然裹了两件人造丝长衬衣，却没有穿大衣。

en.t: Although she had wrapped herself in two long rayon undershirts, she was not wearing an overcoat.
